drafter.private_reasoning: Clean the concealed internal note from the outgoing draft. Use the first round to clarify the payment term and propose a broad release for the Defendant, while preserving ordinary confidentiality exceptions and an enforcement carveout. Do not disclose the client's confidential information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is our opening draft. Please confirm the Settlement Amount and whether the proposed 30-day payment period works. We have also proposed customary release and confidentiality language, including exceptions for legally required disclosures and enforcement of the agreement. We welcome your comments.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff $[●] (the “Settlement Amount”) within 30 days after the Effective Date. Payment shall be made by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff. The parties shall provide any reasonably necessary payment instructions promptly after execution.

2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff, on behalf of itself and its present and former affiliates, and each of their respective predecessors, successors, assigns, officers, directors, employees, agents, and representatives, irrevocably releases and discharges Defendant and its present and former affiliates, and each of their respective predecessors, successors, assigns, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, and representatives, from all claims, demands, causes of action, and liabilities, whether known or unknown, that Plaintiff has or may have arising out of or relating to the facts and claims resolved by this Agreement through the Effective Date. This release does not extend to claims to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep confidential the terms of this Agreement and the negotiations leading to it, and shall not disclose them except to their respective attorneys, accountants, insurers, auditors, and other professional advisers who are bound by confidentiality obligations; as required by law, regulation, or court order (with advance notice to the other party where legally permitted); or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. A party making a permitted disclosure shall, where practicable, limit the disclosure to what is necessary.

4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement and the payment of the Settlement Amount are not, and shall not be construed as, an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or the validity of any claim by Defendant. Defendant denies liability.
